mentions.name: Code-based sewing pattern software
mentions.description: This software creates sewing patterns with code. It includes features such as splitting patterns into PDFs for printing and a timeline that shows how a pattern is constructed segment by segment, making debugging easier. Curves can be grouped so users can view how individual components, like a sleeve, are constructed.
mentions.problem: Debugging how a sewing pattern is constructed is difficult; the timeline makes it much easier to inspect each construction step.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a sewing pattern software to make patterns with code. It has a bunch of useful features like chopping up the pattern into a PDF for printing.
